subject: AtlasBank: SLA exhibit clarifications and 24x7 escalation runbook
messages:
From: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@atlasbank.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlasbank.com
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasBank RFP — Support & TAM questions

Jordan —

Thanks for taking this RFP. We have a handful of detailed questions related to support coverage, escalation windows, and audit evidence that we need to include in the SOW/SLA exhibit. Please see the attached PDF with numbered items. High-level asks:

1) Confirm whether Redwood provides a named TAM and whether that TAM is available during business hours only or 24x7 for severity-1 incidents.
2) Provide your escalation path with estimated RTOs for Sev1/Sev2/Sev3.
3) List communication channels (phone, PagerDuty, email) used for incident notification and confirm SLA targets for initial response and remediation updates.
4) Describe how you handle audit evidence for incident timelines and what logs can be delivered on request (format and retention).
5) Any carve-outs to 24x7 coverage (maintenance windows, third-party infra outages) that would affect AtlasBank.

Can you return answers in-line against the PDF or provide a companion document with the exhibit language? We need this for our Security & Ops review and procurement by Oct 17.

Regards,
Maria Ortiz
Head of Cloud Security — AtlasBank

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Ortiz <maria.ortiz@atlasbank.com>
Cc: samir.patel@atlasbank.com, procurement@atlasbank.com
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 12:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasBank RFP — Support & TAM questions

Maria —

Thanks for the clear list. I've answered inline below and attached a concise runbook and a draft SLA exhibit for your legal/procurement team. Key summary up front: Redwood can provide a named TAM plus 24x7 on-call incident coverage for Sev1 under the Dedicated/Private plans. There are limited carve-outs (planned maintenance and force majeure) which are called out in the draft exhibit; we can discuss narrow language if needed.

--- inline responses ---
1) TAM availability: Named TAM is standard for Dedicated and Private customers. TAM is the primary technical engagement lead during business hours (M–F, 9–5 local). For Sev1 incidents we provide 24x7 escalation to our on-call incident response team and the TAM is notified immediately; TAM participation during off-hours is on an as-needed basis depending on incident complexity and contractual retainer. If you require guaranteed TAM presence on-call, we can include a paid 24x7 TAM retainer in the exhibit.

2) Escalation path & RTOs:
   - Initial triage (on-call responder): initial response < 15 minutes for Sev1, < 1 hour for Sev2.
   - Senior on-call (engineer): engaged within 60 minutes for Sev1, 4 hours for Sev2.
   - TAM/Customer Success: notified immediately for Sev1; engaged within 2 hours for active coordination.
   - Executive escalation: triggered if incident not resolved within 24 hours or on request.

3) Communication channels & update cadence:
   - Notification: PagerDuty (primary), phone escalation (for Sev1 after initial PD alert), and email.
   - Updates: Every 30 minutes for Sev1 until mitigation in place; hourly for Sev2 until resolution. Status pages and incident tickets are updated and linked.

4) Audit evidence & logs:
   - We capture incident timelines, audit trails from our control plane, and per-request logs stored in S3-compatible export (JSON/CSV). Standard retention is 90 days; longer retention available via add-on. Delivery: secure share link or export bundle (PGP-signed) within 3 business days after request.

5) Carve-outs:
   - Planned maintenance: standard maintenance windows (monthly) where short interruptions may occur; affected windows are communicated 7 days in advance and excluded from uptime calculations.
   - Third-party cloud provider outages: Redwood will route and mitigate where possible but cannot guarantee uptime for provider-level incidents; we provide post-incident analysis and evidence.

Attachments: Redwood_Oncall_Runbook_v1.3.pdf (runbook with escalation diagrams) and SLA-Exhibit-Draft-AtlasBank.docx (draft language for SOW).

Next steps: I can present these items to your Security & Ops review or provide a tracked-changes doc for procurement. Would you like a brief call Thursday (Oct 16) to walk through the runbook?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- TAM retainer: we have a standard 24x7 TAM retainer template at $12k/mo that guarantees named TAM participation for Sev1 within 30 minutes and a staffed rotation for off-hours. Recommend offering this as a line item rather than embedding as baseline.
